declarations.name: AuiQuarterPicker
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI QuarterPicker: `<aui-quarter-picker>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible label and accessible name of the group (via aria-labelledby). Must be a non-empty string.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: Inclusive lower bound (validation and popup). Must not be after max.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name; a hidden input carries YYYY-Qn.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text (text only) referenced by the group's aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: An empty entry is invalid (value-missing); segments are required and the required indicator is shown.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the segments and the button; the popup does not open and the value is not submitted.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Focusable and submitted, but not editable; the popup does not open.

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation after the built-in checks; return a non-empty message to mark the value invalid (error 'custom').

inputs.name: isQuarterDisabled
inputs.description: Return true to disable a quarter: focusable in the popup but not selectable; typed, it is invalid (error 'unavailable').

inputs.name: today
inputs.description: Advanced: fixed today instead of the current date in timezone; it decides the current quarter. For tests, server rendering, and demos with a fixed clock.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides: calendar, previous, next, error.

inputs.name: validationTiming
inputs.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

inputs.name: closeOnSelect
inputs.description: Close the popup after a quarter is picked.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Selects the quarterPicker messages (segment pattern, value, cell text and labels), month names in hints, numbers, and messages. A change rebuilds the segments and keeps the entry.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: Zone used only to determine the current quarter (aria-current and default focus).

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Popup and grid direction: grid arrow-key mirroring, chevrons, and popup alignment (applied when the popup opens).

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user changed the value or its validity error (typing, stepping, a separator, or picking a quarter).

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only: Whether the popup is open.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the popup and focus the selected quarter (or the current quarter), clamped to min/max. No-op when open, disabled, or read-only.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the popup; focus inside it returns to the button.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now (for every validation timing) and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); null or '' clears it; cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: YYYY-Qn, or null when the value is null.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Close, restore the initial value, and clear dirty/touched/submitted state (no events).

accessibility.pattern: Segmented quarter field in a labelled group with a button that opens a non-modal dialog popup (WAI-ARIA APG date picker dialog pattern, non-modal variant) containing a paged role=grid of quarters with a roving tabindex.

limitations: Calendar quarters only (Q1 is January to March); a fiscal-year start is not supported.
Only ASCII digits are accepted in segments; other characters are removed.
Segment order and literals come from the `pattern` message, not from Intl; locales without registered quarterPicker messages use the English pattern and labels.
Single quarters only; ranges need two pickers. The popup has no Cancel/OK buttons: picking commits.
Segment arrow navigation follows visual order and is not mirrored in RTL, because segments render as an LTR run.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
